title: Hiring: Senior Manager E-learning Sales
company: TechnoEdge Learning Services India Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company:** Technoedge Learning Services India Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** Pune (Baner)  
**Employment Type:** Full Time (On-site)  
**Experience Required:** 3 to 5 Years

**About TechnoEdge**  
TechnoEdge Learning Services India Pvt Ltd is an enterprise learning company on a mission to deliver innovative, customized, and outcome-driven learning solutions that move organizations forward. We work with 185+ leading enterprises across industries, offering a full-spectrum portfolio custom eLearning, digital learning content, corporate training, microlearning, AI-powered media solutions, multilingual dubbing and localisation, and talent development consulting. With 27,000+ professionals trained and 793+ domain trainers in our network, we don't just build learning programs we build learning ecosystems.

**The Role**  
TechnoEdge is looking for a senior enterprise sales professional to own new business acquisition for our learning content and digital learning portfolio. This is a pure new business role. You will prospect, engage, and close enterprise clients independently — from first conversation to signed contract. No account farming. No team management. Full revenue ownership.

**What You Will Own**

1. End-to-end enterprise sales cycle — prospecting, discovery, solution positioning, proposal, negotiation, closure  
2. New logo acquisition and quarterly revenue targets  
3. Pipeline creation and CRM hygiene across all active opportunities  
4. Executive relationships at CHRO, CLO, L&D Head, and Talent leadership levels

**Who We Are Looking For**  
You currently work or have recently worked in enterprise sales at a learning content, e Learning, or talent development company. You have sold custom eLearning, digital learning solutions, microlearning, or learning consulting services to mid-to-large enterprises. You understand how L&D buying decisions are made, and you have the relationships and credibility to open doors at the right level.

Specifically, you bring:  
1. 3-5 years total experience; minimum 3 years in enterprise learning sales  
2. A clean track record of new logo acquisition and consistent quota achievement  
3. Comfort engaging CHROs, CLOs, L&D Heads, and Procurement in complex sales cycles 4. Commercial sharpness - you understand deal structures, pricing, and value-based selling CRM discipline and reliable forecasting as a standard work habit, not an afterthought  
5. Strong professional network within the L&D and corporate training ecosystem

**What TechnoEdge Offers**  
1. Direct ownership of your market with leadership visibility and zero bureaucracy 2.Competitive fixed compensation + performance incentives on new business  
3. A growing portfolio of learning content and digital learning products to sell with conviction

This role is not suitable for candidates from outside the learning industry, those seeking account management or team leadership responsibilities, or those without a demonstrated enterprise new business track record.

**Apply:** hr@technoedgels.com  
**Contact:** 9225375293

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (F/M) - Permanent - Pune
description:
#### **Shape the future of industrial transformation with We.PLM !**


Join We.PLM, a fast\-growing PLM consulting firm and Dassault Systèmes partner, supporting leading industrial companies across Western Europe. Our growth is driven by one thing: **delivering complex PLM transformations with deep technical excellence, on\-time delivery and proven reliability.**


With 50\+ certified consultants across Europe and India, we are building more than projects, we are building a **Centre of Excellence for PLM architecture and transformation.**


I’m Robin, HR Executive at We.PLM.


I’m searching a recruiter to elevate our talent acquisition in India.


This is where you come in.

#### **Your mission**


As a recruiter you are responsible for hiring best talents in time and offer a smooth candidate experience.


This role demands to support the structuration of recruitment and execute rigorously the policy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Guarantee a clear reference frame in recruitment (recruitment policy, legal, key rules)
* Ensure every candidate has a good experience from hunt/application to onboarding
* Ensure managers apply successfully methodologies
* Support company in attractivity and employee brand
* Defining needs through a clear brief with managers
* Headhunting targeted profiles
* Assessing and evaluating candidates with a standard synthesis
* Support managers in decision making through debrief and score cards
* Ensuring every candidates get a feedback
* Pricing job offers

#### **You might be a great fit if…**

* You have a minimum of 5 years in recruitment including at least 3 years **headhunting** in PLM
* You have a bachelor or a master degree
* You are reliable, rigorous apply precisely methodologies and process defined
* You have an ability to synthesize information
* You conduct processes with proactivity, assertiveness and advisory approach to support managers
* You have good oral communication (clear, structured, concise \& synthetic, precise)
* You have good editorial communication

#### **Why joining We.PLM**

* A high\-expertise environment focused on delivery excellence
* Trainings, access to Dassault Systèmes University and DS certification
* Real career growth opportunities based on your ability to deliver impact and structure transformation
* Direct exposure to clients and strategic projects
* Close collaboration to experienced leaders and founders
* Attractive salary, based on your expertise
* Shared value bonus
* Health insurance
* Flexible working environment
* Strong team culture with team buildings

*Equal opportunities are a priority: we promote inclusion among our employees and provide appropriate accommodations.*

#### **Recruitment path**


HR interview


Manager interview


Final discussion with a director

**Simple. Fast. Transparent.**
